# `atum.model-choice/1.5`: ChatGPT plan through one relay Mac

This R2 version preserves 1.4's accepted shapes and deliberately supersedes its cloud-ChatGPT rejection: `source: chatgpt_plan` is now valid for a cloud destination only through the relay contract. A live grant names the selected owner device service and relay revision, costs zero Atum Protons, and becomes unavailable when the relay is disabled, transferred, revoked, disconnected, or offline. No credential crosses the contract and no failure changes the source to Atum.
